# Zen Design System

> React 19 components, design tokens and icons generated from the Zen Figma library. Import "@zen/design-system/styles.css" once, wrap the app in <ZenProvider>, and pick components from docs/guidelines/index.json by purpose / use / avoid.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.consumer.md](AGENTS.consumer.md): setup, the rules that go wrong most often, API facts, icons, styling
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): install, entry points, ZenProvider modes, dark mode, mobile, icons, fonts
- [docs/guidelines/index.json](docs/guidelines/index.json): every component with purpose, use/avoid, compact props, Do/Don't and harness rules

## Components

- [Button & IconButton](docs/guidelines/button.md): Triggers an action on the current surface (save, submit, open, delete). Navigation between pages is a link, not a Button. Props: docs/api/button.json
- [Chip / Pill](docs/guidelines/chip.md): Compact, selectable tokens. Advanced chips are the Zen filter control: each owns a Popover of options. Props: docs/api/chip.json
- [Input fields](docs/guidelines/input.md): Collect a single value from the user. All fields share Label → Field → Help-Text anatomy and the Leading/Trailing slots. Props: docs/api/input.json
- [Search](docs/guidelines/search.md): Find or filter content by typing. Props: docs/api/search.json
- [Segmented](docs/guidelines/segmented.md): Switch between 2–5 mutually exclusive views or sections of the same content. Props: docs/api/segmented.json
- [Toggle](docs/guidelines/toggle.md): Turn a setting on or off with immediate effect. Props: docs/api/toggle.json
- [Checkbox](docs/guidelines/checkbox.md): Select zero, one or many independent options, or confirm a single statement. Props: docs/api/checkbox.json
- [Radio Button](docs/guidelines/radio-button.md): Pick exactly one option from a small visible set. Props: docs/api/radio-button.json
- [Badge & Badge-Counter](docs/guidelines/badge.md): Non-interactive status, category or count labels. Props: docs/api/badge.json
- [Tag](docs/guidelines/tag.md): A chosen value inside a field (keywords, recipients), usually removable. Props: docs/api/tag.json
- [Avatar & Avatar Stack](docs/guidelines/avatar.md): Represent a person or workspace with a photo or initials. Props: docs/api/avatar.json
- [Popover](docs/guidelines/popover.md): The shared floating list used by Chip, Select, Autocomplete and Leading/Trailing pickers. Props: docs/api/popover.json
- [Sidebar](docs/guidelines/sidebar.md): Primary app navigation with sections, nested items and a collapsible rail. Props: docs/api/sidebar.json
- [Date Picker](docs/guidelines/date-picker.md): Pick a date or a date range. DatePicker is the calendar panel itself and is visible by default (open defaults to true), like an inline calendar; DateField is the input that opens it in a popover (a Bottom Sheet on a phone); DatePickerSheet is the phone picker of Figma Date-Picker/Mobile. Props: docs/api/date-picker.json
- [Tooltip](docs/guidelines/tooltip.md): Name or briefly describe a control on hover and keyboard focus. Props: docs/api/tooltip.json
- [Tabs](docs/guidelines/tabs.md): Switch between related panels of content at the same level. Props: docs/api/tabs.json
- [Breadcrumbs](docs/guidelines/breadcrumbs.md): Show where the current page sits in a hierarchy and let users go up. Props: docs/api/breadcrumbs.json
- [Progress](docs/guidelines/progress.md): Show determinate progress of a task or a step. Props: docs/api/progress.json
- [Modal & Dialog](docs/guidelines/dialog.md): Interrupt to confirm a decision or deliver critical information. Props: docs/api/dialog.json
- [Toast Message](docs/guidelines/toast.md): Brief, non-blocking feedback about something the user just did or something the system just finished. Props: docs/api/toast.json
- [Alert Banner](docs/guidelines/alert-banner.md): A full-width message about a persistent, page- or app-level condition. Props: docs/api/alert-banner.json
- [Accordion](docs/guidelines/accordion.md): Progressive disclosure of secondary content under short headings. Props: docs/api/accordion.json
- [Pagination](docs/guidelines/pagination.md): Move through a large, ordered result set one page at a time. Props: docs/api/pagination.json
- [Skeleton](docs/guidelines/skeleton.md): Placeholder that mirrors the layout of content while it loads. Props: docs/api/skeleton.json
- [Divider](docs/guidelines/divider.md): A 1px line that separates groups of content. Default (Pale) is the everyday rule; Medium and High add emphasis only when the design calls for it. Props: docs/api/divider.json
- [Inline Message](docs/guidelines/inline-message.md): A Subtle-surface message placed inside the content it describes — contextual, persistent until resolved or dismissed. Props: docs/api/inline-message.json
- [Empty State](docs/guidelines/empty-state.md): Explains why a screen or region has nothing to show and what the user can do next. Props: docs/api/empty-state.json
- [Stepper](docs/guidelines/stepper.md): Shows progress through a multi-step, sequential process and where the user is in it. Props: docs/api/stepper.json
- [Slider](docs/guidelines/slider.md): Pick a value from a continuous or stepped range by dragging, where the relative position matters more than the exact number. Props: docs/api/slider.json
- [Card](docs/guidelines/card.md): A surface that groups related content about one subject — a project, a stat, a choice — and can be selected or opened as a whole. Props: docs/api/card.json
- [Dock Icon](docs/guidelines/dock-icon.md): A round, filled icon tile that identifies an app, category, file type or object. Props: docs/api/dock-icon.json
- [Voice](docs/guidelines/voice.md): Record a voice take, or talk with the assistant out loud: a waveform or voice signal, what the state means, and three voice actions around one main action. Props: docs/api/voice.json
- [List Item](docs/guidelines/list-item.md): One row of a vertical list: a leading visual, a title with an optional caption, and a trailing slot for actions or a passive chevron / value. Props: docs/api/list-item.json
- [Table](docs/guidelines/table.md): Rows of structured records that users scan, compare, sort and act on. Props: docs/api/table.json
- [Rating](docs/guidelines/rating.md): Collect or show a quick quality judgement: stars, an emoji opinion, or an NPS score. Props: docs/api/rating.json
- [Color Selector](docs/guidelines/color-selector.md): Pick one colour from a small curated set of swatches. Props: docs/api/color-selector.json
- [Metric Widget](docs/guidelines/metric.md): Show one key number with its label, an identifying icon and how it changed. Props: docs/api/metric.json
- [Uploader](docs/guidelines/uploader.md): Let users add files by dropping or browsing, then track each file's upload. Props: docs/api/uploader.json
- [Side Panel](docs/guidelines/side-panel.md): Show details, filters or an edit form next to the page without leaving it. Props: docs/api/side-panel.json
- [Container borders (Subtle vs Pale)](docs/guidelines/borders.md): Pick the border of a closed container (a stroke or ring enclosing a box on all sides) by whether the box can be acted on: Subtle for actionable, Pale for non-actionable. Dashed strokes are always at least Subtle.
- [Background layers (Canvas → Popover)](docs/guidelines/background-layers.md): Every background sits on one of five layers, bottom to top: 1 Canvas (the page) · 2 Surface (containers on the page) · 3 other colours (component fills: subtle, solid, support) · 4 Container (Modal and Bottom-Sheet) · 5 Popover (floating overlays). Pick the token by the layer the box lives on, never by how it looks.
- [Content colours (text & icons)](docs/guidelines/content-colors.md): Text and icon colours share the Color/Content tokens, but the level depends on the family: neutral families map Strongest/Base/Light to the Primary/Secondary/Tertiary text roles; colour families use Strongest/Base for normal text on Subtle backgrounds and Light only for highlights; the Lights group (colours referencing Sky, Mint, Yellow or Zen) never uses Light for text.
- [File Icon](docs/guidelines/file-icon.md): A coloured document mark that identifies a file's type (PDF, sheet, zip, video …) next to its name. Props: docs/api/file-icon.json
- [Flag](docs/guidelines/flag.md): A round country or region flag that helps people spot a country next to its name. Props: docs/api/flag.json
- [Icon](docs/guidelines/icon.md): Render a system icon from the generated set at a token size. Props: docs/api/icon.json
- [Top Navigation](docs/guidelines/top-navigation.md): The mobile app bar: where you are (title), how to go back (leading) and up to three actions for this screen (trailing). Props: docs/api/top-navigation.json
- [Bottom Navigation](docs/guidelines/bottom-navigation.md): Root-level navigation on mobile: switch between three to five top destinations with one tap. Props: docs/api/bottom-navigation.json
- [Bottom Sheet](docs/guidelines/bottom-sheet.md): A surface that slides up from the bottom for supplementary content, a short task or a list of actions, without leaving the screen. Props: docs/api/bottom-sheet.json
- [Chat](docs/guidelines/chat.md): Person-to-person messaging: a thread of bubbles (text, files, calls, photos) with reactions and read receipts, a composer and a conversation list. Props: docs/api/chat.json
- [AI Chat](docs/guidelines/ai-chat.md): Prompting and conversing with an assistant: a field to ask, answers to read and rate, and an empty state that suggests where to start. Props: docs/api/ai-chat.json
- [Chart](docs/guidelines/chart.md): Show how a value changes over time (Line) or how parts make up a total (Stack bar), framed by a Chart Card with a title and range switch. Props: docs/api/chart.json
- [Layout (Stack, Grid, Box, Container)](docs/guidelines/layout.md): Token-based layout primitives: Stack (one direction), Grid (columns), Box (padding, background layer, border, radius) and Container (page width and margin). They replace hand-written flex/grid CSS so spacing always comes from the Figma scale. Props: docs/api/layout.json
- [Text & Heading](docs/guidelines/text.md): Copy in the Figma text styles and Zen content colours. Heading renders a real h1–h6 whose level follows the page outline; Text covers paragraphs, labels, captions and inline copy. Props: docs/api/text.json
- [App Shell](docs/guidelines/app-shell.md): The frame of a web app: Sidebar navigation, a sticky top bar (a toggle, Breadcrumbs or a Search, then actions and the account menu), the page, and an optional banner, docked side panel and floating action, with a skip link. When the shell is 1024px or wider the Sidebar sits beside the page and the top-bar toggle collapses it to its icon rail; narrower, it opens as a modal drawer from the menu button. Props: docs/api/app-shell.json
- [Page Header](docs/guidelines/page-header.md): The top of an app page: breadcrumbs or Back, the h1 title with its meta and actions, a description and optional section tabs. Props: docs/api/page-header.json
- [Form](docs/guidelines/form.md): Collect a set of values and submit them. Form is a <form noValidate> laid out as a Stack; useFormState holds values and errors and binds every Zen field in one spread; FormField labels custom controls, FormFieldset groups choices and FormActions is the footer row. Props: docs/api/form.json
- [Link](docs/guidelines/link.md): Navigates to another page, section or site from inside text or next to it. It uses the Content/Hyperlink colours and takes the font of the text around it; actions on the page are Buttons. Props: docs/api/link.json
- [Menu](docs/guidelines/menu.md): A button that opens a list of actions for an object: row actions in a table, a card's ⋯, an Edit or New menu. It uses the Popover surface and Popover/Item rows, follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern and floats in the overlay layer. Props: docs/api/menu.json
- [ZenProvider (app root)](docs/guidelines/provider.md): The root of every Zen UI. It sets the token modes (data-theme, data-density…), paints the page Canvas and text colour, and hosts the portal that overlays render into, so dialogs, toasts and menus follow the same modes. Props: docs/api/provider.json
- [Description List](docs/guidelines/description-list.md): Shows read-only term → value pairs in a semantic dl: order summaries and receipts, contact and profile details, specs and metadata. Props: docs/api/description-list.json
- [Action Bar](docs/guidelines/action-bar.md): The footer bar that holds a screen's main actions: the mobile footer CTA (Large, full width, Primary on top), the phone dual footer (Large Tertiary · Primary side by side) and the sticky action row of desktop detail and edit pages (Tertiary · Primary at the end). Props: docs/api/action-bar.json
- [Image & Thumbnail](docs/guidelines/image.md): Shows a picture in a ratio frame that keeps its size while loading (Skeleton) and fails gracefully (neutral placeholder, alt kept). Thumbnail is the fixed square for list rows, tables and pickers. Props: docs/api/image.json
- [Visually Hidden](docs/guidelines/visually-hidden.md): Adds text that only assistive technology reads: names for icon-only table headers, context for repeated links, status announcements, hidden headings and skip links that appear on focus. Props: docs/api/visually-hidden.json

## Optional

- [docs/component-usage-rules.md](docs/component-usage-rules.md): cross-component rules (buttons, borders, content colours, background layers); repo only
